name: AppFlowy-Cloud
description: Step 5/7: AppFlowy Cloud — the core Rust backend providing REST API, WebSocket real-time collaboration, file management, and AI integration. Part of the AppFlowy Cloud stack.

variables.name: Base URL
variables.description: Public-facing base URL of your AppFlowy instance (e.g. http://192.168.1.100 or https://appflowy.yourdomain.com). No trailing slash.

variables.name: JWT Secret
variables.description: Shared JWT secret. MUST be identical to GOTRUE_JWT_SECRET in AppFlowy-GoTrue. Keep private.

variables.name: Web URL
variables.description: URL where AppFlowy Web is served. Usually the same as Base URL.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: PostgreSQL connection string. Update password and host if changed.

variables.name: Redis URI
variables.description: Redis connection URI.

variables.name: GoTrue Base URL
variables.description: Internal URL of the AppFlowy-GoTrue container on the appflowy network.

variables.name: Use MinIO
variables.description: Set true to use MinIO (recommended for self-hosted). Set false to use AWS S3.

variables.name: S3 Access Key
variables.description: S3/MinIO access key. Must match AppFlowy-MinIO MINIO_ROOT_USER.

variables.name: S3 Secret Key
variables.description: S3/MinIO secret key. Must match AppFlowy-MinIO MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD.

variables.name: S3 Bucket
variables.description: S3/MinIO bucket name. Created automatically on first start if APPFLOWY_S3_CREATE_BUCKET=true.

variables.name: MinIO URL (internal)
variables.description: Internal MinIO API URL for container-to-container communication.

variables.name: S3 Presigned URL Endpoint
variables.description: Public-facing URL for MinIO presigned file access. Clients use this to upload/download files directly.

variables.name: Auto-create S3 Bucket
variables.description: Automatically create the S3 bucket on startup if it does not exist.

variables.name: S3 Region
variables.description: AWS S3 region (e.g. us-east-1). Required only when APPFLOWY_S3_USE_MINIO=false.

variables.name: Access Control
variables.description: Enable permission-based workspace access control. Recommended: true.

variables.name: DB Max Connections
variables.description: PostgreSQL connection pool size. Reduce if your Postgres hits connection limits.

variables.name: WebSocket Mailbox Size
variables.description: Max queued WebSocket messages per actor. Higher = more memory; lower may drop messages under load.

variables.name: Whitelist Signup
variables.description: Restrict signup to whitelisted emails. Requires GOTRUE_DISABLE_SIGNUP=false.

variables.name: Guest Invite Approval
variables.description: Require admin approval for guest invitations.

variables.name: Search Service URL
variables.description: Internal URL for the AppFlowy-Search container.

variables.name: Search Request Timeout (s)
variables.description: Timeout in seconds for requests to the search service.

variables.name: AI Enabled
variables.description: Enable AI features. Set false to disable entirely.

variables.name: AI Server Host
variables.description: Hostname of the AppFlowy-AI container on the appflowy network.

variables.name: AI Server Port
variables.description: Port of the AI service.

variables.name: OpenAI API Key
variables.description: OpenAI API key. Required for AI-powered search summaries and document embeddings. Leave empty to disable AI.

variables.name: SMTP Host
variables.description: SMTP host for AppFlowy Cloud mailer (e.g. smtp.gmail.com).

variables.name: SMTP Port
variables.description: SMTP port.

variables.name: SMTP Username
variables.description: SMTP authentication username.

variables.name: SMTP Email
variables.description: Sender email address.

variables.name: SMTP Password
variables.description: SMTP password.

variables.name: SMTP TLS Kind
variables.description: TLS mode: wrapper (port 465), required, opportunistic, or none.

variables.name: AssemblyAI API Key
variables.description: AssemblyAI API key for voice transcription features. Optional.

variables.name: AssemblyAI API Base
variables.description: AssemblyAI REST API base URL.

variables.name: AssemblyAI Streaming Base
variables.description: AssemblyAI streaming API base URL.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Rust log level: error, warn, info, debug, trace.

variables.name: Environment
variables.description: Deployment environment. Keep as production.
